diagnosis: The update method locates the WebhookEndpoint directly via Model::findOrFail without verifying that the webhook belongs to the authenticated team or user account. An attacker can hijack webhook URLs belonging to other tenants to intercept sensitive outbound event payloads such as password resets and payment notices.
